summary: For a non-finger implement on an undisturbed grave, engrave.c::doengrave() calls engrave.c::disturb_grave() and exits before the engraving text phase. The helper prints “You disturb the undead!”, marks the tile disturbed, creates a ghoul through makemon(), then exercises Wisdom. js/engrave.js currently records note_unported("grave.c disturb_grave") and returns, so it skips the entire event. The reported teleport.c::collect_coords RNG draw is downstream of makemon() relocating a hero-square creation through enexto_core(); it is not the source owner. The other production caller is dokick.c::kick_nondoor(), whose JavaScript grave arm still refuses. A source-aligned makemon() runtime call shape is also missing for this NO_MM_FLAGS call, so the creation side effects and observed RNG remain a downstream implementation blocker.

source.branch: When the target is a grave and has not already been disturbed, disturb_grave() emits the undead message, sets rm.disturbed, calls makemon(&mons[PM_GHOUL], x, y, NO_MM_FLAGS) with its return discarded, then calls exercise(A_WIS, FALSE). Its non-grave and already-disturbed paths report impossible conditions and make no state change.
callers: engrave.c::doengrave() at 1024-1030: on a grave, finger-only use reports a smudge; any other implement on an undisturbed grave calls disturb_grave(u.ux, u.uy), then exits. The command-table E entry in cmd.c:1714-1715 routes to doengrave(); the recorded #engrave command reaches the same handler.

dokick.c::kick_nondoor() at 1098-1108: after the grave levitation and minor-injury checks, an undisturbed grave with the 1-in-2 branch calls disturb_grave(x, y). This is the only other direct C call site found.

Current JavaScript caller gaps: js/engrave.js::doengrave() at 954-960 skips the call with note_unported("grave.c disturb_grave"); js/dokick.js::kick_nondoor() at 819-823 throws UnsupportedKickError for the grave arm. Wire both callers when porting the helper.
dependencies: makemon.c::makemon() at 1179-1184 handles a runtime creation requested at the hero square by calling enexto_core() to choose an adjacent square. Its return value is discarded in disturb_grave(), but its creation, RNG, and screen side effects are observable here. js/makemon_create.js::preflightCreation() currently admits explicit-coordinate runtime calls only with MM_NOMSG, and explicit inventoryless hero-square calls with NO_MINVENT|MM_NOMSG; this caller supplies NO_MM_FLAGS and has no source marker, so it reaches the outside-mklev refusal. If makemon.c is not included in source-port scope, retain a named makemon.c gap and do not synthesize its RNG. This call shape blocks parity for the selected screen.

The C byyou placement path calls teleport.c::enexto_core(), which uses teleport.c::collect_coords() to randomize nearby squares; the evaluation’s next C draw is rn2(8)=0 at collect_coords:700. js/teleport.js already implements enexto_core()/collect_coords(); this is a downstream path skipped because the grave helper and makemon() call are absent, not an independent teleport.c source-owner finding.
attrib.c::exercise(A_WIS, FALSE) runs after monster creation. js/attrib.js already exports exercise(); preserve the C ordering and normal Wisdom state/RNG effects.

evidence: The saved evaluation challenges/evaluations/20261001190602-v17.json at 518d4526ccba82c89752a8babb892ba9bc48bc60 reports 20/21 screens, 3107/3159 RNG calls, and 21/21 cursors. Its first mismatch is segment 0, zero-based step 20, key a: C has glyph Y where JavaScript has W; C’s next call is rn2(8)=0 from collect_coords(teleport.c:700).

The immutable recipe challenges/cases/v17/engrave-on-wished-undisturbed-grave-disturbs-it.recipe.session.json (SHA-256 16d1cf36d86545556db7efb37da6b036f5d12a2a0cc446127d4467057d01f3bf) uses seed 41827461, wishes a grave underfoot, then enters #engrave and selects key a. The recipe comment calls the callee grave.c:disturb_grave, but that comment is stale: the actual C definition is in engrave.c.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/engrave.c:1019-1030 shows doengrave() taking the non-finger, undisturbed-grave branch, calling disturb_grave(), and exiting. engrave.c:1705-1721 defines disturb_grave(): message, lev->disturbed = 1, discarded-result makemon(PM_GHOUL, x, y, NO_MM_FLAGS), then negative Wisdom exercise.

The direct C call-site search finds engrave.c:1028 and dokick.c:1106. dokick.c:1098-1108 confirms the separate kick caller and its 1-in-2 undisturbed-grave condition. cmd.c:1714-1715 registers E to doengrave(). The accepted-preparation retainedCases row for this exact case likewise records reachedSource engrave.c:doengrave -> engrave.c:disturb_grave and identifies engrave.c as owner; the C source confirms it.

Upstream makemon.c:1179-1184 routes hero-square runtime creation through enexto_core(); teleport.c:242-257 gathers nearby candidate coordinates, and teleport.c:700 draws rn2(n) while shuffling. Existing js/teleport.js contains enexto_core()/collect_coords, while js/makemon_create.js:1293-1307 and 1439-1483 do not admit this NO_MM_FLAGS call shape. This accounts for why the RNG annotation names a downstream caller.

Current gaps are visible in js/engrave.js:954-960 (wrongly named note_unported skip) and js/dokick.js:819-823 (UnsupportedKickError for grave kicking). A search of nethack-c/patches for disturb_grave found no direct patch hunk; upstream engrave.c defines the behavior under investigation.

callerWiring: Replace the grave branch skip in js/engrave.js::doengrave() with the helper call and exit matching C.
Replace the grave refusal in js/dokick.js::kick_nondoor() with the helper call for the C 1-in-2 undisturbed-grave branch; preserve its preceding levitation/injury checks and other unrelated refusals.

unresolvedCallDependency.status: The helper’s C call discards the return, but the call’s source side effects produce the ghoul, adjacent placement, RNG, and glyph seen in this case. Current JavaScript preflight rejects its NO_MM_FLAGS runtime shape. Record this precise gap if the source-aligned runtime route is not included; the case will remain unmatched until this behavior is supported.

wholeFunctionBranches: Invalid non-grave: C impossible diagnostic only.
Already disturbed grave: C impossible diagnostic only.
Undisturbed grave: message, set disturbed, create ghoul at an adjacent valid location through makemon(), then exercise Wisdom downward.
